'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Jake Pietruszewski LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jake Pietruszewski]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' jake.irish
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
